description: CANONICAL hero roster. Edit heroes here only, then run: node tools/generate-hero-data.mjs. It regenerates Assets/Chronicles/HeroRosterData.g.cs and shared/hero-catalog.json.
rules: Never rename or remove an existing id: player saves reference it (see shared/heroes/legacy-hero-ids.json).
Never lower the rarity of a released hero.
EX rarity is locked; no EX hero may be added without owner approval.
All player-facing text must be English (en-US).
